context: A pressure case is exo own skill test; a plugin eval is the Claude Code built-in way to test a plugin. Both give the model a hard task and check if the skill makes it behave right. Pressure case: lives in benchmarks/pressure/<skill>/; skills/edit-skills/scripts/pressure.mjs runs it with and without the skill; no script grades it, a person or agent reads the result against criteria.md; runs once by default (DEFAULT_RUNS = 1). Plugin eval: `claude plugin eval`, built into Claude Code since 2.1.269; cases live in evals/; graders score runs automatically (match text, check tool use, or model judge); runs each case 3 times by default, also with no plugin loaded; reports the gap between the two.

facts: pressure case is exo's own skill test
